promptSummary: Create Observation 005 / Game 005, Gravity Atlas: a PC-first deterministic physics puzzle for the Physics Experiment Hall, with a shared pure physics engine, six gravity plates, shot budgets, clear win/loss, and a committed Node verifier proving every plate completable. Wire it into the launcher, halls, manifest, changelog, README, and generated index.

performed: node scripts/verify-gravity-atlas.mjs (passed): the committed verifier imports the same engine module the browser runs and replays the embedded reference launch vectors, confirming all six plates end in a target hit within budget and under the power cap

Plate design search: solutions were found by random launch-vector search through the real engine (about 3k-11k samples per plate to collect 40 hits each, giving rough hit-rate difficulty bands); Plate V was redesigned once after an initial layout proved unsolvable in 400k samples

Static HTTP serve via python3 -m http.server 4173: HTTP 200 for the game page, both source modules, the stylesheet, styles/game-shell.css, library.html, observation.html?slug=gravity-atlas, play.html?slug=gravity-atlas, games/manifest.json, game.json, and the variant.json
pending: Interactive in-browser smoke (title render, drag-aim, fire, trajectory animation, plate progression, win and loss overlays, pause/help, console-error check) at 1280x800, 1440x900, 1920x1080, and 390x844 — not run in this authoring environment because no browser is available
Real captured browser screenshots (screenshot-title.png, screenshot-plate.png, screenshot-complete.png)
Physical handset QA for the mobile baseline

knownIssues: No screenshots are captured or claimed; game.json and the manifest declare no media so the launcher shows an explicit no-screenshot state.
Interactive in-browser smoke and console-error verification were not performed in this environment; node-level checks, the committed completability verifier, and static HTTP serving were performed.

Reference-solution replay is bit-identical on V8 runtimes (Node and Chromium); the integrator avoids transcendental functions, but cross-browser float behavior of manual play has not been verified in a browser.
Mobile is declared limited; drag-aiming works as a touch gesture in principle but was not verified in a browser, and no physical handset QA is claimed.
notes: Gravity Atlas's physics lives in games/gravity-atlas/src/engine.js, a pure module shared verbatim by the page and by scripts/verify-gravity-atlas.mjs, so the completability proof exercises exactly the shipped simulation: fixed-timestep (1/120s) semi-implicit Euler over softened inverse-square wells, using only arithmetic and Math.sqrt for cross-runtime determinism. Six plates escalate from an open field to a three-mass void corridor; each carries a shot budget (lose when exhausted) and a par (score bonus). window.__gravityAtlasQA exposes start, restart, getSnapshot, setAim, fire, fireVector, autoSolveShot (fires the proven reference vector for the current plate), simulate, forceWin, and forceLose.
